strengths.why: Takes any one enemy out of the fight while it holds, however big or well armoured, and can shelter a teammate the same way.
Finds hidden enemies and targets for the team beyond its own sight.

weaknesses.why: Holds one target for a short fixed time and does no damage while it lasts: nobody can hurt the held enemy either, and it comes back where it was when the time is up.
Information only: the scan deals no damage, and a wasted one leaves the team blind until the cooldown ends.

countered_by.why: Long-range fire hits the caster from beyond the reach of its prison shot, and only one target at a time is ever locked away.
Locked out of its abilities, it can't cast the prison at all.
Fast units are out of the scanned area before the team can act on what it showed.
A head-on armoured push does not rely on hiding, so the scan has little to uncover.
This kind of damage works well against this unit's armour, shields or body.

counters.why: Armour makes no difference: the heaviest tank is held out of the fight as surely as a soldier.
Stealthy units are shown to the whole team for as long as the reveal lasts.
Cloaked units inside the scan are uncovered for the team.
Burrowed or submerged units inside the scan are uncovered for the team.
A scan lights up what hides under a shroud field, at least for a moment.

counterplay: Kill or interrupt the caster: a beam or channel ends the moment it does, and the target comes back unharmed.
Struggle out of a beam hold: the held player holds F to fill a break bar, and the beam snaps if the bar fills before the erase does.
Leave the scanned area before the team can act, or stand still against motion sensors, which miss enemies that are not moving.

signature.name: Glacier Hold
signature.effect: A targeted shot locks one enemy or teammate away for a short fixed time; there is no erase, and the target returns where it was when the time runs out.

team_play_hook.text: Defenders get a clear rescue job: find and kill the caster, who is fragile and standing still.

how_it_plays.as_user: You pick one target and take it out of the fight: the enemy tank that was winning is suddenly a statue nobody can touch, so your team fights the rest of theirs a player short. Scan where trouble is coming: a flank, a capture point, the gap a cloaked enemy has to cross, or the ground your artillery wants to hit.
how_it_plays.as_target: Your screen greys out and your unit is frozen in place inside a visible shell; you can still watch the fight and ping, but you can't move or fire. Against a beam you are not helpless: hold F, the universal shake-off, to struggle. A second bar fills while you struggle and the beam snaps when it is full, so an erase becomes a race between the two bars. Timed prisons and fields can't be shaken off, but they are short.
how_it_plays.teammates: Attackers use the hold to win a numbers fight: lock the enemy's biggest threat, then focus the rest.
how_it_plays.tells: A distinct stasis look, such as a clock-like shell or a desaturated, translucent body, clearly different from ice (which means freeze and shatter: shoot it) so players know shots are wasted.
